content.text: I reviewed the entire agreement (single section, 75 paragraphs) and searched for MFN-style formulations ("most favoured/favored", "no less favourable", "best terms").

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms provision in either direction. Searches for "most favoured/favored", "no less favourable", "favorable" and "best terms" returned no hits, and the only commercial terms provision (§5 Fees and Payment, p0023) simply defers revenue-share economics to the applicable Exhibits without any obligation on AP to match or extend terms given to third parties. Section 1 (p0001) affirmatively confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and does not restrict AP from offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties, which is directionally favourable to us. Consistent with the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), no redline is required. If a fees Exhibit is later added, MFN or best-terms language running against AP should be checked at that point.
